memories.summary: Mara's mother was diagnosed with atrial fibrillation around 2026-04-05 after experiencing palpitations and feeling faint; Chidi took her to a hospital in Lagos and she was started on medication.

entities.name: Chidi
entities.description: Mara's sibling who is in Lagos caring for their mother

memories.summary: Mara is an ICU nurse living an ocean away from her family in Lagos, Nigeria.
Mara's mother raised three children largely alone after Mara's father was gone.

On 2026-04-05 Mara felt helpless and guilty over her mother's diagnosis, judging herself useless for being far away and 'the one who left'; she considered flying to Lagos and planned to call her mother that night.
